patterns.description: Gerund codes naming recurring behavioral processes. Each pattern is evidenced by multiple segments.

pattern_name.description: Gerund name of 2-6 words. Captures the recurring behavioral process.

definition.description: 2-3 sentences defining what this pattern captures: what behavior recurs, under what conditions, with what variation.

segment_refs.description: 1-based indices of segments that evidence this pattern.

confidence.description: How strongly the segments converge on this pattern.

incidents.description: Evidence one-liners. Concrete things the participant did, said, felt, or experienced.

description.description: One-liner describing what happened. Plain language, no gerunds.

segment_refs.description: 1-based indices of segments this incident comes from.

patterns.description: 0-based indices of patterns that this incident supports. Optional.

exact_quote.description: Verbatim quote from the segment that best captures this incident. Optional.

prime_mover.description: What seems to drive this participant's behavior? 2-3 sentences.

prime_mover_confidence.description: Confidence in the prime mover assessment.

tentative_concern.description: What is this participant continuously trying to resolve? A gerund phrase.

anomalies.description: Segments or patterns that don't fit or require verification. Optional.

needs_verification.description: true if this document contains patterns that should be flagged for verification.
